steps.what: Design microsystem topology and specify process, functional and package constraints for layouts
Create routine schematic elements and physical layout geometry from the specified parameters
Check schematic connectivity, physical layout and constraint consistency before accepting the design version

tasks.design: Configure native parameterized cells and schematic templates in microsystem design software {OTHER}. The engineer retains device topology, process interpretation and complete design checking before accepting an exact version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Routine geometry and schematic elements were entered repeatedly after their dimensions and relationships had been specified.
tasks.enabler_now: Native parameterized cells can instantiate specified elements deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Process limitations and functional behavior are not established by geometric rule checks alone.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recognizes interactions between device physics, process limits and packaging.
tasks.altitude: Routine element creation shrinks while design judgement and acceptance remain unchanged.

reach.task: Review device connectivity and packaging interfaces
reach.learn: Interface consistency and physical layout constraints

evidence.claim: Native parameterized design elements can generate specified geometry and schematic components; this microsystem-specific saving is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary covers schematic and layout creation, excluding fabrication, prototype testing and formal manufacturing release.

The microsystems engineer produces in s1 topology, connectivity, dimensions and units, layer mapping, process-rule version, package envelope, interface locations and functional constraints. Design decisions and capture remain counted; unsupported cells or incomplete constraints require manual layout.
OTHER denotes microsystem schematic and physical layout software. Test native cells and templates before custom code; existing cell instantiation earns no new saving.
Only repetitive element entry in s2 is removed. Complete connectivity, geometry and engineering checks retain s3 time; passing software rules does not prove physical performance.
unknowns: Process-rule access and routine element entry burden
research_questions: Does native cell generation save time after constraint specification and complete design checking?

already_counted.description: Connectivity, constraint and physical layout checking

incremental.description: Maintain checked cell parameters and process mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact schematic, connectivity, physical layout, process-rule version and design findings accepted in s3; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R75 gross25 minus8 upkeep gives net17. Range0-4 assumes existing parameterized cells and substantial bespoke geometry; physical design judgement retains time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Specify microsystem simulation models, candidate designs and cost or performance investigation scenarios
Run specified design scenarios and collect comparable cost, performance or process capability measures
Investigate result validity and interpret the design's cost, performance and process limitations

tasks.design: Configure native scenario runs and result tables in simulation software {OTHER}. The engineer chooses physical assumptions and checks convergence, independent limiting cases and process relevance before interpreting the findings in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated run setup and result extraction consumed time between modeling decisions and interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native batch scenarios can execute specified cases and tabulate selected measures.
tasks.still_hard: Model validity and real process capability require evidence beyond successful execution.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recognizes misleading simulation results and unsupported extrapolation.
tasks.altitude: Repeated scenario handling shrinks while model judgement and interpretation remain unchanged.

reach.task: Assess material-property assumptions for device behavior

evidence.claim: Native scenario execution can automate repeated setup and result collation without validating a physical model; savings here are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary includes investigation specification, repeated run interaction and interpretation, excluding solver runtime and physical fabrication trials.

The microsystems engineer produces in s1 model version, geometry, properties and units, boundary conditions, process assumptions, scenario bounds, result measures, cost assumptions where relevant and independently derived check cases. Capture and physical model decisions remain counted; unsupported input ranges require manual investigation.
OTHER denotes microsystem simulation software. Test native batch and report functions before custom code. Existing unattended solver operation is not human effort.
s3 retains all validation time, including convergence and comparison with independent expected behavior. Scenario results do not establish manufacturability automatically.
research_questions: Does configured scenario handling save time after setup and independent model checks?

already_counted.description: Model validity and process relevance interpretation

incremental.description: Maintain scenario templates and result mappings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R75 gross25 minus8 upkeep gives net17. Range0-4 assumes existing batch support and frequent invalid input ranges; model judgement and solver runtime earn no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Create and maintain formal engineering documents

steps.what: Define engineering document content and verify current component, material and packaging details
Create document views, bills of materials and specification tables from checked design inputs
Check engineering document meaning, consistency and revisions before accepting the package

tasks.design: Configure native design-document outputs in {OTHER} and controlled templates in {DOCS}. The engineer defines technical content and checks each generated view and specification before accepting the package.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same checked component and design details were recopied into several formal documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates can render structured design fields into consistent views and tables.
tasks.still_hard: A consistent document can still contain an incorrect technical requirement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer judges whether the documents express the actual design intent and limitations.
tasks.altitude: Document assembly shrinks while technical authorship and acceptance remain unchanged.

reach.task: Review interface and component specification consistency
reach.learn: Revision control and unambiguous technical requirements

evidence.claim: Native design outputs and document templates can render checked structured details without deciding technical content; savings here are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary includes document content definition, assembly and technical acceptance, excluding creating the underlying new design and external manufacturing release.

The microsystems engineer produces in s1 design version, component identifiers, quantities and units, checked material specifications, packaging limits, approved view references and document revision metadata. Content judgement and capture remain counted; unsupported fields require manual document preparation.
OTHER denotes engineering design and document-output software. Test native BOM, view and specification outputs before custom code; existing automatic documents earn no saving.
Schematic design itself belongs to the separate layout task; this task only renders an existing checked design. Allocate shared content preparation once in roll-ups.
research_questions: Do native outputs save assembly time after metadata preparation and technical package checks?

already_counted.description: Technical meaning, consistency and revision acceptance

incremental.description: Maintain document field mappings and controlled templates

approvals.approved_version: Exact package views, component quantities, specifications, packaging limits and revision snapshot checked in s3; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R60 gross40 minus7 upkeep gives net33. Range0-7 assumes considerable existing native outputs and metadata repair; technical definition and checking retain time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define failure, reliability or yield questions and verify comparable device and test evidence
Calculate specified failure, reliability or yield measures and comparison tables
Check statistical meaning and investigate causes before concluding the failure or yield analysis

tasks.design: Configure native statistical tables in {OTHER} from an engineer-checked dataset and analysis specification. The engineer checks assumptions and investigates causes; calculated associations do not establish a failure mechanism or improvement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated statistical setup and collation delayed interpretation of comparable test evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: Native analysis functions can repeat specified measures and tables deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Censoring, selection effects and physical failure mechanisms require specialist judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer connects statistical findings to actual device behavior and further investigations.
tasks.altitude: Repeated calculation shrinks while analysis validity and causal conclusions remain unchanged.

reach.task: Investigate physical causes of device failure

evidence.claim: Native statistical functions can calculate specified reliability and yield measures; validity and causal interpretation remain human and savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary covers analysis preparation, calculations and interpretation, excluding creating the underlying physical test observations and implementing improvements.

The microsystems engineer produces in s1 device or lot identifier, design revision, test condition, exposure or duration with units, observed outcome, observation end, censoring status justified from source evidence, inclusion criteria and selected statistical method. Verification and capture remain counted; uncertain outcomes or incompatible observations require manual investigation.
OTHER denotes statistical analysis software. Test native reliability functions and reports before custom code; no free failure classification or cause flag is assumed.
Existing test producers retain their collection work. Existing automatic analysis earns no saving, and interpretation retains all s3 time.
research_questions: Does reusable calculation save time after validating outcomes, censoring and statistical assumptions?

already_counted.description: Statistical validity and physical cause interpretation

incremental.description: Maintain analysis definitions and checked data mappings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R70 gross30 minus8 upkeep gives net22. Range0-5 assumes existing statistical functions and substantial source-data problems; physical cause investigation retains time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Routine geometry, scenario handling, document assembly and statistical preparation may shrink while device physics and technical judgement remain with the engineer.
reach: Review component interfaces with electronics engineers
Investigate physical failures with materials engineers
role.ambitious_version: A microsystems engineer with more repeatable preparation and unchanged responsibility for physical validity and engineering conclusions.
